prompt: Which allocation fills both requests this afternoon and preserves a usable spare?
promptZh: 哪種分配能在今天下午備妥兩項需求，並留有可用備品？

options.text: Elmar: two P14 and three P22; test units: two more P22.
options.zh: 艾爾瑪：兩個 P14、三個 P22；測試機：另兩個 P22。
options.whyZh: 雖然都是細電纜零件，但客戶工單不能混鎖扣。

options.text: Elmar: five P14; test units: two P14.
options.zh: 艾爾瑪：五個 P14；測試機：兩個 P14。
options.whyZh: 今天只有六個未保留的 P14，不能拿七個。

options.text: Elmar: five P14; test units: two P25.
options.zh: 艾爾瑪：五個 P14；測試機：兩個 P25。
options.whyZh: 客戶部分可行，P25 卻是粗電纜，測試機也不能用。

options.text: Elmar: five P14; test units: two P22.
options.zh: 艾爾瑪：五個 P14；測試機：兩個 P22。
options.whyZh: 六個可用 P14 中分五個給客戶；測試機可用細電纜的 P22，並仍留有細電纜備品。

explanationZh: 六個可用 P14 中分五個給客戶；測試機可用細電纜的 P22，並仍留有細電纜備品。
evidence: P14 | thin | lever | 8 / P22 | thin | sliding | 6 / The shelf quantities include two P14 plugs set aside for a training session. / A test unit may use either lock style if the cable size matches. / The Elmar plugs must be ready now; the bench units may use anything allowed by the counter reference, but please keep at least one usable thin-cable plug as a spare after filling both requests. / Kara from training can release the two reserved plugs tomorrow, not this afternoon.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The shelf quantities include two P14 plugs set aside for a training session.
A test unit may use either lock style if the cable size matches.
The Elmar plugs must be ready now; the bench units may use anything allowed by the counter reference, but please keep at least one usable thin-cable plug as a spare after filling both requests.
Kara from training can release the two reserved plugs tomorrow, not this afternoon.

vocabulary.note: 先保留給特定用途，不算人人可先取用的庫存。
